verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents managing dashboards as code: the full dashboard spec can be read, downloaded or hand-edited as JSON, and that same passage implies an API path. Service accounts provide programmatic API access intended for CI/CD pipelines and automation. Alerts-as-code and repeatable provisioning workflows are not concretely documented, and no Terraform provider appears in the evidence. missing for 10: Terraform provider, documented alert-rule JSON/API provisioning, published API reference (OpenAPI probe returned 404), a documented repeatable import/provisioning workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably

citations.quote: Edit a dashboard as JSON: read, copy, download or hand-edit the whole spec in the app, without going through the API.
Use them for CI/CD pipelines, automation scripts, external integrations, and any non-human system that needs to interact with the SigNoz API.
